summary.zh-CN: Composio 官方远程 MCP（Composio Connect），用少量通用工具发现并执行 1000 多个应用的操作。由 Teloa 以 OAuth（动态客户端注册 + PKCE）授权；各应用的账号连接和令牌由 Composio 平台保管，请求经 Composio 服务器转发。
summary.en: Composio's official remote MCP (Composio Connect) that discovers and runs actions across 1000+ apps through a few general tools. Authorized by Teloa via OAuth (dynamic client registration + PKCE); app connections and tokens are held by the Composio platform, and requests are relayed through Composio's servers.

description.zh-CN: 执行已连接应用的工具

conditions.zh-CN: 需在 市场 > 连接 页由本人在浏览器中用 Composio 账户完成 OAuth 授权；服务器部署需在配置文件设置 oauth.publicCallbackUrl
conditions.en: The owner must complete OAuth authorization with a Composio account in a browser from Market > Connections; server deployments must set oauth.publicCallbackUrl in the config file

conditions.zh-CN: Composio 是聚合平台：你在 Composio 连接的各个应用，其账号令牌由 Composio 保管，每次调用都经 Composio 服务器转发到对应应用。COMPOSIO_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL 可以修改已连接应用里的数据，Teloa 对它的每次调用逐次确认。
conditions.en: Composio is an aggregation platform: it holds the account tokens of every app you connect there, and each call is relayed through Composio's servers to that app. COMPOSIO_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL can change data in connected apps, and Teloa asks for confirmation on every call.

conditions.zh-CN: 服务地址为 connect.composio.dev/mcp（旧地址 mcp.composio.dev/mcp 已停用）。授权服务器公开的配置信息支持动态客户端注册（token_endpoint_auth_method none）与 PKCE S256，令牌与注册由 login.composio.dev 处理；2026-09-27 实测客户端注册成功、授权页正常跳转到 Composio 登录页。
conditions.en: The service address is connect.composio.dev/mcp (the old address mcp.composio.dev/mcp is retired). The authorization server's published configuration supports dynamic client registration (token_endpoint_auth_method none) and PKCE S256, with tokens and registration handled by login.composio.dev; on 2026-09-27 client registration succeeded and the authorization page redirected to the Composio sign-in page.

conditions.zh-CN: 同一套 OAuth 流程已在 Cloudflare 连接器上用真实账户走通（注册、授权、令牌交换、工具调用）。
conditions.en: The same OAuth flow has been run end to end with a real account on the Cloudflare connector (registration, consent, token exchange, tool calls).

conditions.zh-CN: 登录 Composio 之后的令牌交换与工具调用未经 Teloa 真实账户实测，工具清单按官方文档列出；使用中遇到问题请在资源详情页点「问题反馈」。
conditions.en: Token exchange and tool calls after signing in to Composio have not been tested with a real account by Teloa, and the tool list follows the official documentation; if something does not work, use Report a problem on the resource page.
